Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Secure portal invite + initial CAIQ mapping request

Hi Lukas —

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. As discussed, we can onboard Redwood to the Vendr security portal so your team can manage the CAIQ/SIG artifacts and respond to a scoped questionnaire. To keep the kickoff tight, can you:  

- Provide a recent CAIQ export (PDF or XLS) or a short list of modules you expect to mark "N/A".
- Confirm a technical contact for portal invites and an admin who can approve evidence uploads.
- Tell us whether you prefer temporary portal credentials or SSO (we support OIDC SSO and SAML).

I attached a small checklist and a template for a CAIQ gap-log that we find helpful for later handoffs. Once we have the CAIQ snapshot we will pre-fill the SIG mapping and surface any obvious gaps for discussion.

Attachments: portal_tempcreds_README.txt (stub), caiq_gap_log_template.xlsx (stub)

Portal invite link will be issued once we receive the admin email.

Cheers,
Priyanka Shah

priynka@vendr.io | +1 415-555-0142

Thanks — looping in Mina (security lead) and Marissa (vendor ops) to own the upload and mapping. A few quick notes:  

1) We can provide a CAIQ snapshot exported from our internal evidence tracker; I will attach a PDF export for the initial pass.
2) For onboarding, temporary credentials are fine for the first 72 hours; long term we plan to use OIDC SSO (Okta). Please include SSO configuration docs in the portal invite so we can validate the assertion consumer URL and certificate details.
3) Admin: mina.haddad@redwood.inference — please make her a Portal Admin so she can approve evidence and respond to SIG questions.

I'll attach the CAIQ snapshot and a short internal mapping note. Marissa — can you confirm whether procurement needs a PO or signed MSA before we accept the portal invitation?

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>

Cc: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@vendr.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Secure portal invite + initial CAIQ mapping request

Thanks — I grabbed the CAIQ snapshot and started a gap log. A few observations from a quick triage:  

- We have older artifacts for key SOC 2 controls (logging, monitoring) that need TTL/retention dates updated in the portal.
- Several CAIQ statements around key management and HSM integration point to our KMS design doc (I attached a pointer).
- We will need Vendr to allow file-level metadata so we can tag evidence by SOC 2 control id (example: CC5.1). If the portal only supports freeform filenames we will coordinate a naming convention.

Marissa — procurement: we will accept the portal invite without a PO for onboarding/testing, but require procurement to complete commercial approval before production-level access (FYI).

I attached an initial caiq_gap_log_zenfold.xlsx with the first-pass rows filled and short notes; Priyanka — if you can set our portal admin up with temp creds for 72 hours we will upload the PDF snapshot + a couple of S3-signed proof files. Also, can you confirm whether Vendr supports pre-signed S3 links as evidence?

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Security Lead — Redwood Inference
Attachments: caiq_gap_log_zenfold.xlsx (stub)

From: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@vendr.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, vendor-portal@vendr.io
Date: Thu, 25 Jan 2028 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Secure portal invite + initial CAIQ mapping request

Hi Mina / Lukas —

Appreciate the gap log — that was helpful. Quick responses inline:  

- Temp creds: created for mina.haddad@redwood.inference, valid 72 hours from portal-invite-accept. Invite link: https://app.vendr.io/portal/invite/ABCD-zenfold (same as the onboarding link above).
- File-level metadata: we do support custom tags and control-id fields; I will enable a "control_id" metadata column on your account so uploads can be filtered and exported.
- Pre-signed S3 links: supported for 'proof' uploads but we guarantee a 7-day URL retention window; for longer-lived proof we recommend uploading documents directly into the portal.

I also pre-filled a CAIQ/SIG scaffold for the sections you flagged; you'll see a batch of auto-mapped answers once you accept the invite. I attached a short export of the scaffold we generated for your review (caiq_scaffold_zenfold.xlsx).

Next steps:  
1) Mina accepts the invite and uploads the CAIQ PDF + two sample proof artifacts.
2) We run an automated mapping job and surface any open requirements.
3) Schedule a 30-minute sync to triage high-risk gaps (I can do Jan 30–31).

If procurement still needs a PO for production access we can toggle a policy that restricts publish-level access until signoff.

Best,
Priyanka
Vendor Onboarding — Vendr
Attachments: caiq_scaffold_zenfold.xlsx (stub)
